clips.send: Your port. One spot on a coast. The red pin is a port on a coast, like Savannah, Georgia. As Earth spins, the port passes a high, a low, a high and a low in each lunar day (about 24 hours 50 minutes). Watch the “Port water level” bar under the model while Earth spins.

clips.send: Moon. The main cause of tides. The Moon’s gravity pulls on Earth and its oceans. It pulls hardest on the side closest to it. The Moon goes around Earth about once a month, so it is in a slightly different place each day. Earth has to turn about 50 extra minutes to face the Moon again, so high tide comes about 50 minutes later each day.

The Moon goes around Earth about once a month, so it is in a slightly different place each day.. Earth has to turn about 50 extra minutes to face the Moon again, so high tide comes about 50 minutes later each day.

clips.send: Sun. Makes tides bigger or smaller. The Sun also raises tides, but its effect is a bit less than half of the Moon’s (about 46 percent). Sun, Earth and Moon in a line, the pulls add up, spring tides. Sun and Moon at a right angle, the pulls partly cancel, neap tides.

clips.send: Far-side bulge (high tide). Water “left behind”. On the side facing away from the Moon, the water is pulled LESS than Earth’s center. Earth gets pulled toward the Moon a little more than this water, so the water is left behind and bulges out. So there are two high tides at the same moment, on opposite sides of Earth.
clips.text: Far-side bulge (high tide). Water “left behind”. On the side facing away from the Moon, the water is pulled LESS than Earth’s center.. Earth gets pulled toward the Moon a little more than this water, so the water is left behind and bulges out.. So there are two high tides at the same moment, on opposite sides of Earth.

clips.send: Low tide. Water drawn away from the sides. Halfway between the two bulges (90° from the Moon), the water is lower: low tide. The water that builds the bulges comes from these regions. A coast usually has a low tide about 6 hours 12 minutes after each high tide.
clips.text: Low tide. Water drawn away from the sides. Halfway between the two bulges (90° from the Moon), the water is lower: low tide.. The water that builds the bulges comes from these regions.. A coast usually has a low tide about 6 hours 12 minutes after each high tide.

clips.send: Near-side bulge (high tide). Water pulled toward the Moon. Ocean water on the side facing the Moon is pulled more strongly than Earth’s center. Water piles up here, making a high tide. In the open ocean this bulge is only about half a meter tall. The model is hugely exaggerated!
clips.text: Near-side bulge (high tide). Water pulled toward the Moon. Ocean water on the side facing the Moon is pulled more strongly than Earth’s center.. Water piles up here, making a high tide.. In the open ocean this bulge is only about half a meter tall. The model is hugely exaggerated!

clips.send: The Moon’s pull. Weaker with distance. Gravity gets weaker with distance. The near side of Earth is about 12,700 km (one Earth diameter) closer to the Moon than the far side, so it feels a stronger pull. The DIFFERENCE in pull across Earth stretches the oceans into two bulges. Scientists call it the tidal force.
clips.text: The Moon’s pull. Weaker with distance. Gravity gets weaker with distance.. The near side of Earth is about 12,700 km (one Earth diameter) closer to the Moon than the far side, so it feels a stronger pull.. The DIFFERENCE in pull across Earth stretches the oceans into two bulges. Scientists call it the tidal force.

clips.send: Earth. Spins once a day under the bulges. Earth rotates once about every 24 hours, carrying every coast through both bulges. That is why most coasts get two high tides and two low tides each day. The bulges stay lined up with the Moon while Earth turns underneath them.

clips.send: 地球。每天自转一周，从隆起下面转过。地球大约每 24 小时自转一周，把每一段海岸都带着穿过两个隆起。所以大多数海岸每天有两次高潮和两次低潮。两个隆起始终对着月球的方向，地球在它们下面转动。
clips.text: 地球. 每天自转一周，从隆起下面转过. 地球大约每 24 小时自转一周，把每一段海岸都带着穿过两个隆起。. 所以大多数海岸每天有两次高潮和两次低潮。. 两个隆起始终对着月球的方向，地球在它们下面转动。

clips.send: 月球的引力。距离越远越弱。引力随距离增大而减弱。地球近月侧比远月侧离月球近约 12,700 千米（一个地球直径），所以受到的拉力更大。地球各处受到的拉力“不一样大”，这个差别把海洋拉成两个隆起，科学家称之为引潮力。
clips.text: 月球的引力. 距离越远越弱. 引力随距离增大而减弱。. 地球近月侧比远月侧离月球近约 12,700 千米（一个地球直径），所以受到的拉力更大。. 地球各处受到的拉力“不一样大”，这个差别把海洋拉成两个隆起，科学家称之为引潮力。

clips.send: 低潮。两侧的海水被抽走。在两个隆起之间（与月球方向成 90 度 的地方），水位较低，这就是低潮。形成隆起的海水就是从这些地方“借”来的。一般来说，高潮过后大约 6 小时 12 分钟会出现低潮。
clips.text: 低潮. 两侧的海水被抽走. 在两个隆起之间（与月球方向成 90° 的地方），水位较低，这就是低潮。. 形成隆起的海水就是从这些地方“借”来的。. 一般来说，高潮过后大约 6 小时 12 分钟会出现低潮。

clips.send: 太阳。让潮汐变大或变小。太阳也会引起潮汐，但它的作用略小于月球的一半（约 百分之46）。日、地、月排成一条直线，引力叠加，大潮。太阳和月球与地球成直角，引力部分抵消，小潮。
clips.text: 太阳. 让潮汐变大或变小. 太阳也会引起潮汐，但它的作用略小于月球的一半（约 46%）。. 日、地、月排成一条直线 → 引力叠加 → 大潮。. 太阳和月球与地球成直角 → 引力部分抵消 → 小潮。

clips.send: 远月侧隆起（高潮）。被“留在后面”的海水。在背对月球的一侧，海水受到的拉力比地心更小。地球被月球拉过去的程度比这里的海水稍多一些，于是海水被“留在后面”，也鼓了起来。所以同一时刻地球两侧各有一个高潮。
clips.text: 远月侧隆起（高潮）. 被“留在后面”的海水. 在背对月球的一侧，海水受到的拉力比地心更小。. 地球被月球拉过去的程度比这里的海水稍多一些，于是海水被“留在后面”，也鼓了起来。. 所以同一时刻地球两侧各有一个高潮。

clips.send: 近月侧隆起（高潮）。被拉向月球的海水。面向月球一侧的海水，受到的拉力比地心更大。海水在这里堆积起来，形成高潮。在开阔的大洋上，这个隆起只有大约半米高，模型把它夸大了很多倍！
clips.text: 近月侧隆起（高潮）. 被拉向月球的海水. 面向月球一侧的海水，受到的拉力比地心更大。. 海水在这里堆积起来，形成高潮。. 在开阔的大洋上，这个隆起只有大约半米高，模型把它夸大了很多倍！

clips.send: 你的港口。海岸上的一个地点。红色图钉代表海岸上的一个港口，比如美国佐治亚州的萨凡纳。地球自转时，港口在每个“太阴日”（约 24 小时 50 分钟）里依次经过高潮、低潮、高潮、低潮。地球转动时，留意模型下方的“港口水位”条。

clips.send: 月球。潮汐的主要成因。月球的引力拉着地球和地球上的海洋，离它最近的一侧受到的拉力最大。月球大约一个月绕地球转一圈，所以它每天的位置都略有不同。地球要多转大约 50 分钟才能再次正对月球，所以高潮每天大约推迟 50 分钟。
